findings.title: `CompletionQueue.getResult` now reports `error.Closed` for open queues.
findings.detail: When a stale select wake wins and `completed.pop()` is null, this code now returns `error.Closed` unconditionally instead of only when drained. That makes `Closeable!*Completion` consumers unable to distinguish real queue shutdown from a transient protocol glitch, so existing callers that treat `error.Closed` as terminal can tear down while the queue is still open and operations are still pending. The change also contradicts the file’s own documented contract that `error.Closed` means drained. Fix by preserving the drained-only meaning of `error.Closed` (or introducing an explicit third outcome and updating select/callers to re-poll on it).
